_provenance.notes: Alaska limited entry permits are issued to individuals for specific gear types in specific areas. They are property rights that can be sold, transferred, and used as collateral. Permit values serve as a market indicator of expected fishery profitability. Data from CFEC transfer records. Values are median permit sale price for active permits in a given year.
